description.value: Sidney Bakery is a landmark family-owned institution on Beacon Ave in the heart of Sidney, established in 1903 and in the same family for over 70 years. Famous locally for gooey cinnamon rolls, powdered donuts, butter croissants, and sausage rolls, it uses recipes unchanged since 1944. Cyclists passing through Sidney on Vancouver Island will find a well-stocked range of breads, pastries, sandwiches, and sweets available for pickup or online pre-order.
